title: Discovery of Novel Endolytic Hyaluronate Lyases Belonging to a New Subfamily of GH56 and Enhancement of Catalytic Activity through Catalytic Cleft Engineering.
authors: Yu, Xiangfan; Jing, Yiwen; Liu, Lei; Ma, Zhenyu; Jiang, Xukai; Xu, Li; Xiao, Min
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文发现GH56新亚家族内切型透明质酸裂解酶并通过催化裂隙工程提升活性，虽以酶为对象，但利用分子动力学模拟分析结构-功能关系，对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
abstract: Hyaluronate lyases have been widely used to degrade hyaluronic acid (HA) and prepare HA oligosaccharides. To date, no hyaluronate lyase has been reported in glycoside hydrolase family 56 (GH56). Herein, SpskHL from Sporothrix schenckii 1099-18 was first identified as a GH56 endolytic hyaluronate lyase, and then its four homologues were discovered. These five microbial GH56 enzymes cleaved HA, yielding unsaturated HA oligosaccharides with DeltaHA2 as the end product, forming a new GH56 subfamily of endolytic hyaluronate lyase. Through alanine-scanning mutagenesis of 15 residues in the catalytic cleft of SpskHL and combining three positive mutations, triple-site mutant SpskHLM3 (Y120A/N125A/H189A) increased activity by 126%. Grafting of the triple-site mutation onto four other hyaluronate lyases increased their activities by 74%-155%. Molecular dynamics simulations suggested that all five triple-site mutants had an expanded catalytic cleft, a larger cavity near the catalytic residue E, and a shorter catalytic OE2-O4 distance, which might contribute to their enhanced activities.
abstract_zh: 透明质酸裂解酶已被广泛用于降解透明质酸（HA）并制备HA寡糖。迄今为止，在糖苷水解酶家族56（GH56）中尚未报道过透明质酸裂解酶。本研究首次将来自申克孢子丝菌1099-18的SpskHL鉴定为GH56内切型透明质酸裂解酶，随后发现了其四个同源物。这五种微生物GH56酶能够切割HA，生成以DeltaHA2为终产物的不饱和HA寡糖，从而形成了一个新的GH56亚家族，即内切型透明质酸裂解酶。通过对SpskHL催化裂隙中15个残基进行丙氨酸扫描诱变，并结合三个正向突变，三突变体SpskHLM3（Y120A/N125A/H189A）的活性提高了126%。将三突变位点移植到其他四种透明质酸裂解酶上，其活性提高了74%-155%。分子动力学模拟表明，所有五个三突变体均具有扩大的催化裂隙、靠近催化残基E的更大空腔，以及更短的催化OE2-O4距离，这可能有助于其增强的活性。
